words.example: Our company is launching a nouveau product line to attract younger consumers.

words.chinese: 新奇的事物；新穎的特點（通常指具有吸引力或獨特性的事物）
words.engDef: the quality of being new and unusual; also a small cheap toy
words.example: The company introduced a novelty product to attract new customers during the holiday season.

words.chinese: 提供；提出（建議、機會等）
words.engDef: made available for someone to accept
words.example: The company offered a special discount to attract new customers.

words.chinese: 供品；提供的服務或產品（通常指為了吸引顧客或提升價值）
words.engDef: the products or services a company provides
words.example: Our company's diverse offerings cater to a wide range of client needs.

words.chinese: 提供（服務、產品、優惠等），提出（建議、方案等）
words.engDef: makes something available for someone to accept
words.example: The company offers a wide range of financial products to meet diverse customer needs.

words.chinese: 油畫；以油彩繪製的畫作
words.engDef: a picture painted with oil-based colours
words.example: The art gallery is showcasing a collection of stunning oil paintings by emerging artists.

words.chinese: 公開展示；陳列
words.engDef: placed where people can look at it
words.example: The new product line will be on display at the trade show next week.

words.chinese: 正在打折出售；特價
words.engDef: available to buy, often at a reduced price
words.example: The winter coats are currently on sale for 30% off.

words.chinese: 在市場上供應或銷售；可供購買的
words.engDef: available for people to buy
words.example: The new smartphone is now on the market and is receiving positive reviews.

words.chinese: 可利用的有利條件或情況，常指在商業或職場中可帶來成長、收益或職涯發展的機會。
words.engDef: favourable situations that make something possible
words.example: We need to identify new market opportunities to increase our quarterly revenue.

words.chinese: 裝飾性的；不實用的，主要用於美觀。
words.engDef: made to look attractive rather than to be useful
words.example: The hotel lobby featured ornamental fountains and sculptures to create a luxurious atmosphere.

words.chinese: 奧斯卡獎；（通常指）奧斯卡金像獎，是美國電影藝術與科學學院頒發的年度電影獎項。
words.engDef: a well-known American film award
words.example: Winning an Oscar can significantly boost a film's visibility and sales.

words.chinese: 已絕版；不再印刷
words.engDef: no longer being produced by the publisher
words.example: The publisher announced that the classic novel is now out of print and will not be reprinted.

words.chinese: 超越、勝過（他人或事物），在某方面表現得更好。
words.engDef: to do better than someone else
words.example: Our new marketing campaign aims to outdo the competition in terms of customer engagement.

words.chinese: 外展
words.engDef: the effort to reach and help people outside your usual group
words.example: We need to outreach this carefully.

words.chinese: 銷售額超過；賣得比...好
words.engDef: to sell in greater numbers than something else
words.example: Our new product significantly outsells the competitor's model.

words.chinese: 小冊子;宣傳手冊
words.engDef: a small thin book giving information
words.example: The tourist information center provides free pamphlets about local attractions.

words.chinese: 涼亭；展覽館；展覽大廳（通常指用於展示或舉辦活動的建築物）
words.engDef: a building used for exhibitions or events
words.example: The company showcased its latest products in a beautifully designed pavilion at the trade fair.

words.chinese: 流動攤販；兜售物品的人
words.engDef: a person who travels around selling small goods
words.example: The company hired a peddler to distribute flyers in the downtown area.

words.chinese: 表演者；演出者（通常指專業的演員、音樂家等）
words.engDef: people who act, sing, or play music for an audience
words.example: The company hired several performers to entertain guests at the product launch event.

words.chinese: 客製化；針對個人或特定需求進行調整
words.engDef: to change something so it suits one particular person
words.example: Our marketing team is working to personalize the email campaign to increase engagement.

words.chinese: 客製化；針對個人需求調整的
words.engDef: made to suit one particular person
words.example: Our company offers personalized marketing campaigns to reach specific customer segments.

words.chinese: 說服
words.engDef: to make someone agree to do or believe something
words.example: We need to persuade this carefully.

words.chinese: 攝影師，負責拍攝照片的人，通常在商業環境中指專業的攝影師。
words.engDef: a person who takes photographs
words.example: The marketing team hired a photographer to capture high-quality images for the new product launch.

words.chinese: 松樹；（多種）松木
words.engDef: tall evergreen trees with needle-shaped leaves
words.example: The resort's marketing campaign highlighted the scenic beauty of the surrounding pines.

words.chinese: 民意調查；意見調查
words.engDef: a survey of people's opinions
words.example: The marketing team conducted a poll to gauge customer satisfaction with the new product.

words.chinese: 一種球類運動，通常指由馬球運動衍生而來，騎馬進行的運動；也指此項運動的服裝或風格。
words.engDef: a ball game played on horseback; also a style of shirt
words.example: The company launched a new line of polo shirts targeting young professionals.

words.chinese: 流行巨星；備受歡迎的音樂偶像，通常指在音樂產業擁有廣大粉絲群體的歌手。
words.engDef: a famous singer of popular music
words.example: The company is collaborating with a popstar to promote their new product line.

words.chinese: 使…普及；使…流行
words.engDef: to make something liked by many people
words.example: The company launched a marketing campaign to popularize its new product among young consumers.

words.chinese: 廣為人知的；普遍被接受的
words.engDef: by most people; in the way most people do
words.example: The product was popularly known for its innovative design and user-friendly interface.

words.chinese: （尤指英國）高雅、時髦的；上流社會的；精緻的
words.engDef: elegant and fashionable, often expensive
words.example: The company aims to position its products as posh and exclusive to attract high-end consumers.

words.chinese: 定位
words.engDef: the way a product is presented against its rivals
words.example: The company's new positioning initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.

words.chinese: 海報；張貼的廣告或公告
words.engDef: a large printed notice put on a wall
words.example: The marketing team designed a vibrant poster to promote the new product launch.

words.chinese: 海報；宣傳海報
words.engDef: large printed notices put on walls
words.example: The marketing team is designing posters to promote the new product launch.

words.chinese: 潛在客戶；可能成為客戶的人或公司
words.engDef: a person who might buy from you in future
words.example: Our marketing campaign is designed to identify and attract potential customers.

words.chinese: 極其珍貴的；具有很高價值的（通常指情感或非物質價值）
words.engDef: of great value, or much loved
words.example: The company views its customer relationships as its most precious asset.

words.chinese: 贈送；呈現；展示
words.engDef: gives something formally; also gifts
words.example: The company presents its new product line at the international trade fair.

words.chinese: 新聞稿
words.engDef: an official statement issued to newspapers giving information on a matter
words.example: The company issued a press release to announce the acquisition of its competitor.

words.chinese: 享有盛譽的；聲望顯赫的；受人尊敬的
words.engDef: respected and admired as important
words.example: Our company aims to secure a partnership with a prestigious international firm.

words.chinese: 最高價格；價格上限（通常指零售商或供應商設定的最高售價）
words.engDef: the highest price allowed or charged
words.example: The retailer set a pricemax of $50 for the promotional item.

words.chinese: 價格策略；定價
words.engDef: the setting of prices for goods and services
words.example: The company is currently reviewing its pricing strategy to remain competitive in the market.

words.chinese: 首要的；主要的；優良的（指產品或服務）
words.engDef: of the best quality; also main or most important
words.example: Our company aims to offer prime quality products at competitive prices.

words.chinese: 獎品；獎勵（通常指多個獎品）
words.engDef: rewards given to winners
words.example: The company offered attractive prizes to incentivize employee participation in the sales competition.

words.chinese: 產品；商品；成果
words.engDef: something made or grown to be sold
words.example: Our company is launching a new product next month to meet the growing market demand.

words.chinese: 產品展示；商品陳列，通常指在商店或展覽中展示商品的方式。
words.engDef: an arrangement of goods set out for customers to see
words.example: The store is planning a new product display to attract more customers during the holiday season.

words.chinese: 產品標誌；品牌圖案，通常用於識別和推廣公司或產品。
words.engDef: the symbol that identifies a product or brand
words.example: The company invested heavily in designing a memorable product logo to enhance brand recognition.

words.chinese: 顯著地；突出地；引人注目地
words.engDef: in a way that is very easy to notice
words.example: The company's logo was prominently displayed on all marketing materials.

words.chinese: 有希望的；前景看好的；有潛力的
words.engDef: showing signs of being successful in future
words.example: The company's new product line shows promising results in the initial market tests.

words.chinese: 推廣（產品、服務或品牌）或提升（員工的職位或職責）
words.engDef: to advertise a product; also to give someone a higher post
words.example: The company will promote the new product through a series of online advertisements.

words.chinese: 推廣；促進；鼓勵
words.engDef: advertises a product; also raises someone to a higher post
words.example: The company promotes its new product through online advertising and social media campaigns.

words.chinese: 推廣；促進；提升（銷售、產品、活動等）
words.engDef: advertising a product to increase sales
words.example: The company is promoting its new product line through social media campaigns.

words.chinese: 用於推廣產品或服務的，旨在吸引顧客或提高知名度的。
words.engDef: used to advertise and increase sales
words.example: The company launched a promotional campaign to boost sales during the holiday season.

words.chinese: 促銷活動；升遷
words.engDef: activities to increase sales; also moves to higher posts
words.example: The company is offering special promotions on all summer products to boost sales.

words.chinese: 公開展示；公共展示（通常指產品、廣告或資訊）
words.engDef: an arrangement of things set out for everyone to see
words.example: The company invested heavily in a public display of its new electric vehicle at the auto show.

words.chinese: 公共關係（常簡寫為 PR）
words.engDef: the professional maintenance of a favorable public image by a company
words.example: The corporate communications manager handles all public relations matters.

words.chinese: 公共關係部門，負責塑造和維護企業與公眾之間的良好關係，包括媒體溝通、危機管理、品牌形象塑造等。
words.engDef: the section that manages a company's public image
words.example: The public relations department is responsible for managing the company's image and reputation.

words.chinese: 公開傳播；公眾注意，通常指透過媒體的宣傳活動。
words.engDef: the attention given to someone or something by the media
words.example: The company launched a major publicity campaign to promote its new product.

words.chinese: 公開宣傳；廣泛宣佈（某事）
words.engDef: to make something widely known to the public
words.example: The company plans to publicize its new product line through social media and online advertising.

words.chinese: 將...公開出售；將...列為出售
words.engDef: to make goods available for customers to buy
words.example: The company decided to put the excess inventory out for sale at a discounted price.

words.chinese: 陳列展示；擺放供人觀賞
words.engDef: to arrange goods where customers can see them
words.example: The store manager instructed the staff to put out the new collection for display near the entrance.

words.chinese: 摸彩活動；抽獎
words.engDef: a competition in which numbered tickets are drawn for prizes
words.example: The company is holding a raffle to raise money for charity.

words.chinese: 聚集；集結；反彈（價格、銷售額等）
words.engDef: a large public meeting; also a recovery in prices
words.example: Despite the initial setback, the sales team managed to rally and exceed their quarterly target.

words.chinese: 高度評價；極佳好評
words.engDef: a very enthusiastic report praising something
words.example: The new product received rave reviews from industry experts, leading to a significant increase in sales.

words.chinese: 讀者群；讀物受眾
words.engDef: the people who read a particular publication
words.example: The magazine boasts a large readership among young professionals.

words.chinese: 值得推薦的；可推薦的，通常指產品、服務或方案等。
words.engDef: good enough to be recommended to others
words.example: This software is highly recommendable for small businesses looking to streamline their operations.

words.chinese: 兌換；換取（通常指使用優惠券、獎勵點等獲得商品或服務）
words.engDef: to exchange a voucher or coupon for goods
words.example: Customers can redeem their loyalty points for a free coffee.

words.chinese: 可兌換的；可換取的（通常指獎勵、優惠券等）
words.engDef: able to be exchanged for goods or money
words.example: The loyalty program offers redeemable points for frequent purchases.

words.chinese: （通常指通過行動或犧牲）抵償、補救；（票券、優惠券等）兌換、折抵
words.engDef: the exchanging of a voucher for goods or money
words.example: The company offered a redemption program to encourage customers to return defective products.

words.chinese: 發布；釋放；（產品、資訊等）發佈
words.engDef: to make a product or information available
words.example: The company plans to release the new product line next quarter.

words.chinese: 發布日期；上市日期（指產品、軟體、電影等正式發布或上市的日期）
words.engDef: the day on which a product is made available
words.example: The company announced the release date for the new software is October 26th.

words.chinese: 發布；釋放；（產品、資訊等）推出
words.engDef: makes a product or information available
words.example: The company plans to release its new smartphone model next month.

words.chinese: 享有盛名；以卓越而聞名
words.engDef: the state of being widely known and admired
words.example: The company's renowned quality control process ensures customer satisfaction.

words.chinese: 轉售；再銷售
words.engDef: the selling of something you have bought
words.example: The company focuses on both primary sales and the resale of used electronics.

words.chinese: 零售商店，指直接向消費者販售商品或服務的商業場所。
words.engDef: a shop that sells goods directly to the public
words.example: The company is planning to open several new retail stores in major cities.

words.chinese: 零售商；銷售業者，通常指從製造商那裡購買商品並直接銷售給消費者的公司。
words.engDef: businesses that sell goods directly to the public
words.example: Many retailers are offering discounts to attract customers during the holiday season.

words.chinese: 對產品、服務、工作表現等進行評估或評論的報告或意見
words.engDef: reports giving opinions about the quality of something
words.example: The marketing team monitors online reviews to adjust the product's positioning.

words.chinese: 競爭對手；競爭者，尤指在商業或體育領域。
words.engDef: people or companies competing with each other
words.example: Our company faces fierce rivals in the smartphone market.

words.chinese: （新產品、服務或政策）逐步推出；實施；發布
words.engDef: to introduce a new product or service in stages
words.example: The company plans to roll out the new software update to all users next month.

words.chinese: 進行宣傳活動；推廣（產品、候選人等）
words.engDef: to carry out a planned series of promotional actions
words.example: The company is running a campaign to promote its new line of eco-friendly products.

words.chinese: 刊登一篇報導或文章；發布一篇報導。
words.engDef: to publish a piece of writing in a newspaper
words.example: The marketing team plans to run an article about the new product launch in a popular business magazine.

words.chinese: 亞軍；獲得第二名的參賽者或團隊
words.engDef: the person or team that finishes second
words.example: Despite being the runner-up in the sales competition, she demonstrated exceptional dedication and teamwork.

words.chinese: 銷售額；銷售行為；銷售部門
words.engDef: the goods sold, or the money made from selling them
words.example: The company reported a significant increase in sales this quarter.

words.chinese: 銷售數字；指公司在特定期間內的銷售額或銷售量
words.engDef: the number showing how much has been sold
words.example: The sales figure for the last quarter exceeded our expectations.

words.chinese: 銷售簡報：為推銷產品或服務而設計的演示，通常包含數據、圖表和說服性論點。
words.engDef: a talk given to persuade someone to buy
words.example: The marketing team is preparing a compelling sales presentation for the upcoming trade show.

words.chinese: 銷售報告，記錄銷售數據和分析的文檔，用於評估銷售績效並制定銷售策略。
words.engDef: a document showing how much has been sold
words.example: The marketing team needs to analyze the sales report to identify areas for improvement.

words.chinese: 銷售代表，負責向客戶推廣和銷售產品或服務的專業人員。
words.engDef: a person whose job is to sell a company's products
words.example: Our sales representatives are trained to provide excellent customer service and close deals effectively.

words.chinese: 銷售目標：公司或部門在特定期間內預計達成的銷售額或銷售量。
words.engDef: the amount a company aims to sell in a period
words.example: The regional manager set a sales target of $5 million for the next fiscal year.

words.chinese: 銷售趨勢，指銷售額在一段時間內呈現的變化模式，通常用於分析市場變化和預測未來銷售狀況。
words.engDef: the general direction in which sales are moving
words.example: The latest sales trend shows a significant increase in online purchases.

words.chinese: 銷售人員；店員，負責協助顧客選購商品並完成銷售。
words.engDef: a shop assistant who serves customers
words.example: The salesclerk helped me find the perfect gift for my boss.

words.chinese: 銷售員；推銷員，通常指在商店或公司負責銷售產品或服務的人。
words.engDef: a man whose job is selling goods
words.example: The salesman demonstrated the features of the new product to the potential clients.

words.chinese: 銷售人員；銷售代表，通常指負責推銷產品或服務的專業人士。
words.engDef: people whose job is selling goods
words.example: Our company employs a team of experienced salespeople to increase sales revenue.

words.chinese: 銷售員；銷售代表，負責推銷產品或服務。
words.engDef: a person whose job is selling goods
words.example: The salesperson demonstrated the features of the new software to the potential client.

words.chinese: 藍寶石；（比喻）高價值、珍貴的事物或品質
words.engDef: a bright blue precious stone
words.example: The marketing campaign highlighted the sapphire-quality craftsmanship of the luxury watch.

words.chinese: 鮮紅色；深紅色（通常指一種明亮的紅色，常與高階品牌或特殊場合相關）
words.engDef: a bright red colour
words.example: The company's new marketing campaign features a striking scarlet color scheme to attract attention.

words.chinese: 雕塑品；雕刻作品，通常指藝術品或裝飾品。
words.engDef: works of art carved or shaped from solid material
words.example: The museum's collection features a wide range of sculptures from various cultures.

words.chinese: 因季節而異的；季節性的
words.engDef: happening or changing with the seasons of the year
words.example: The company offers seasonal promotions to attract customers during holidays.

words.chinese: 尋求者；探索者（通常指尋找資訊、機會或解決方案的人）
words.engDef: people who are looking for something
words.example: Our marketing campaign targets job seekers looking for career advancement.

words.chinese: 細分
words.engDef: the dividing of a market into groups of similar buyers
words.example: The company's new segmentation initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.

words.chinese: 賽琳娜（Selena），通常指美國流行歌手賽琳娜·戈梅茲（Selena Gomez）的英文名，在商務情境中可能指稱與該藝人相關的品牌、產品或活動。
words.engDef: a female first name
words.example: The marketing team is leveraging Selena Gomez's popularity to promote the new skincare line.

words.chinese: 銷售者；賣家
words.engDef: a person or company that sells something
words.example: The seller is responsible for promoting the product and closing deals.

words.chinese: 銷售；販售；銷售行為
words.engDef: the activity of persuading people to buy
words.example: The company is focusing on increasing its selling price to improve profit margins.

words.chinese: 銷售；販售
words.engDef: exchanges goods for money
words.example: The company sells a wide range of electronic devices online.

words.chinese: 續集；後續作品（通常指電影、書籍等）
words.engDef: a book or film that continues an earlier story
words.example: The studio is considering a sequel to the successful film franchise.

words.chinese: 展示、展覽；突出展現（優點、產品等）
words.engDef: to display something in a way that shows its best qualities
words.example: The company will showcase its latest innovations at the international trade fair.

words.chinese: 展示廳；展覽室（通常指汽車、家具等產品的展示場所）
words.engDef: a large room where goods are displayed for sale
words.example: The car dealership has a large showroom displaying the latest models.

words.chinese: 展示；呈現；播放（節目、影片等）
words.engDef: displays something; also public performances or exhibitions
words.example: The marketing campaign shows a significant increase in brand awareness.

words.chinese: （表演、產品等）令人驚豔的亮點，能立刻吸引全場注意，使其他事物黯然失色。
words.engDef: something so impressive that it takes all the attention
words.example: The new marketing campaign's innovative video was a real showstopper at the industry conference.

words.chinese: 急劇上升；迅速增長（尤指價格、銷售量等）
words.engDef: to rise extremely quickly
words.example: Sales of the new product skyrocketed after the celebrity endorsement.

words.chinese: 流線型、光滑的；外觀精緻、現代的
words.engDef: smooth, shiny, and stylish in design
words.example: The company's new smartphone boasts a sleek design and cutting-edge technology.

words.chinese: 標語；口號；廣告詞
words.engDef: a short memorable phrase used in advertising
words.example: The company launched a new advertising campaign with a catchy slogan.

words.chinese: 煙霧警報器，用以偵測煙霧並發出警報的裝置，確保安全。
words.engDef: a device that sounds an alarm when it senses smoke
words.example: The building's fire safety regulations require smoke detectors in every office and meeting room.

words.chinese: （價格、銷售額等）大幅上漲；（股票、銷售額等）激揚，節節攀升
words.engDef: to rise very quickly to a high level
words.example: Sales of the new product soared after the successful marketing campaign.

words.chinese: 急劇上升；節節攀升（尤指價格、銷售額等）
words.engDef: rising very quickly to a high level
words.example: Sales of the new product are soaring thanks to the effective marketing campaign.

words.chinese: 售出；銷售
words.engDef: exchanged goods for money
words.example: The company sold over 10,000 units of the new product in its first month.

words.chinese: （票務、商品等）售罄，銷售完畢
words.engDef: completely sold, with none left
words.example: The concert tickets sold out within an hour of going on sale.

words.chinese: 請求（某人提供資訊、服務或支持），通常用於正式場合或商業情境。
words.engDef: to ask someone for money, support, or business
words.example: The company is soliciting bids from various contractors for the new office building project.

words.chinese: 歌曲；樂曲（通常指多首歌曲的集合）
words.engDef: short pieces of music with words
words.example: The company is using popular songs in its advertising campaign to attract a younger demographic.

words.chinese: 壯觀的；令人印象深刻的；傑出的
words.engDef: very impressive to look at
words.example: The company launched a spectacular marketing campaign to boost sales.

words.chinese: 大手筆花費；鋪天蓋地地花費（通常指購買昂貴物品或享受奢華體驗）
words.engDef: to spend a lot of money on something special
words.example: The company splashed out on a new marketing campaign to boost sales.

words.chinese: 華麗的光彩；壯麗的景象；卓越的風采
words.engDef: magnificent beauty and grandness
words.example: The hotel's splendor and luxurious amenities attracted a large number of international guests.

words.chinese: 贊助；提供資金或資源支持
words.engDef: to pay for an event or activity in return for advertising
words.example: Our company is proud to sponsor the annual charity golf tournament.

words.chinese: 贊助；提供資金支持
words.engDef: paid for by a company in return for advertising
words.example: The conference was generously sponsored by several leading tech companies.

words.chinese: 由…贊助；由…提供資金支持
words.engDef: paid for by the named company or organisation
words.example: The conference was sponsored by several leading technology companies.

words.chinese: 贊助商；資助者（通常指為活動、組織或個人提供資金或資源的機構或個人）
words.engDef: companies that pay for events in return for advertising
words.example: Our company is seeking sponsors for the upcoming charity golf tournament.

words.chinese: 贊助；贊助合約；後援
words.engDef: the paying for an event in return for publicity
words.example: The company secured a lucrative sponsorship deal with the sports team.

words.chinese: 廣泛告知；宣傳；讓消息傳播開來
words.engDef: to tell many people about something
words.example: We need to spread the word about our new product launch to attract more customers.

words.chinese: 以星號標示；受到高度評價
words.engDef: appeared as a main performer; also marked with a star
words.example: The hotel was starred in several travel guides for its exceptional service.

words.chinese: 激發、刺激（潛能、興趣、需求等），促使發展或活動。
words.engDef: to encourage something to grow or become more active
words.example: The company launched a new marketing campaign to stimulate demand for its products.

words.chinese: 商店開幕；開業
words.engDef: the first day a new shop begins trading
words.example: The store opening event will feature special discounts and giveaways.

words.chinese: 店鋪的正面或櫥窗，通常指零售店面向街道的部分。
words.engDef: the part of a shop that faces the street
words.example: The company invested heavily in renovating the storefront to attract more customers.

words.chinese: 令人驚豔的；極好的；非凡的（通常指外觀或品質）
words.engDef: extremely beautiful or impressive
words.example: The new marketing campaign features a stunning visual presentation.

words.chinese: 風格；款式；樣式（指設計、服裝、行為等方面的特徵或趨勢）
words.engDef: the particular ways things are designed or done
words.example: The company is launching a new line of clothing with a modern and minimalist style.

words.chinese: 風格設計；造型設計；（產品）外觀設計
words.engDef: the design of the way something looks
words.example: The company invested heavily in product styling to appeal to younger consumers.

words.chinese: 以時尚、時髦的樣式；以引人注目的風格
words.engDef: in a fashionable and attractive way
words.example: The marketing team presented the new product campaign stylishly, capturing the audience's attention.

words.chinese: 訂閱者；訂戶（通常指訂閱服務或刊物的對象）
words.engDef: a person who pays regularly to receive a service
words.example: Our marketing team is focused on increasing the number of subscribers to our monthly newsletter.

words.chinese: 訂閱者；訂閱戶（通常指訂閱服務、新聞、頻道等的用戶）
words.engDef: people who pay regularly to receive a service
words.example: Our marketing campaign aims to increase the number of subscribers to our newsletter.

words.chinese: 訂閱；成為...的訂閱者
words.engDef: paying regularly to receive a service or publication
words.example: Many customers are subscribing to our monthly newsletter for exclusive deals.

words.chinese: 擁有超凡能力並以保護他人為己任的英雄人物，通常具有正義感和強烈的道德觀。
words.engDef: an imaginary character with extraordinary powers
words.example: Our marketing campaign features a superhero character to symbolize the strength and reliability of our product.

words.chinese: 支持者；擁護者（通常指對某組織、產品或理念提供支持的人）
words.engDef: people who help or approve of a person or cause
words.example: The company is launching a loyalty program to attract and retain supporters.

words.chinese: 至高無上的；頂級的；卓越的
words.engDef: highest in rank or quality
words.example: The company aims to offer supreme quality products to maintain its market leadership.

words.chinese: 調查；意見調查（通常用於收集數據和分析結果）
words.engDef: a set of questions asked to find out people's opinions
words.example: The marketing team conducted a customer satisfaction survey to identify areas for improvement.

words.chinese: 調查；問卷調查
words.engDef: sets of questions asked to find out people's opinions
words.example: The marketing team conducted surveys to gauge customer satisfaction with the new product.

words.chinese: 客製化；為特定需求而設計的
words.engDef: made specially to suit a particular need
words.example: We offer tailor-made solutions to meet the unique challenges faced by each client.

words.chinese: 高大優美的（形容詞），通常指建築、景觀或人物，帶有令人印象深刻的視覺效果。
words.engDef: a name used for a brand
words.example: The hotel boasts a tallbeauty of a lobby with soaring ceilings and elegant chandeliers.

words.chinese: 塔拉（地名），通常指印度的一個城市或地區，在商業語境中可能指該地區的產品、貿易或投資。
words.engDef: a place name, also a female first name
words.example: Our market research indicates a growing demand for handcrafted goods from Tara.

words.chinese: 鎖定目標
words.engDef: aiming a product or message at a particular group
words.example: The company's new targeting initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.

words.chinese: 目標；針對的對象或事物
words.engDef: the results or groups a plan aims at
words.example: Our marketing campaign aims to reach a younger demographic as our primary target.

words.chinese: 推薦信；證明信（通常由客戶或使用者提供，用以證明產品或服務的品質）
words.engDef: a written statement praising a product or person
words.example: The company used customer testimonials in its latest marketing campaign to build trust.

words.chinese: 以特定主題為設計或規劃的
words.engDef: built around one particular subject or idea
words.example: The hotel offers a variety of themed rooms, such as a Parisian suite and a tropical getaway.

words.chinese: 令人興奮的；刺激的；引人入勝的
words.engDef: very exciting
words.example: The new marketing campaign promises a thrilling experience for our customers.

words.chinese: 雷暴，暴雨雷電
words.engDef: a storm with thunder and lightning
words.example: Due to the approaching thunderstorm, we're postponing the outdoor promotional event.

words.chinese: 修飾照片，通常指對照片進行細微調整，例如調整色彩、亮度或去除瑕疵，以改善其外觀。
words.engDef: to make small improvements to a picture
words.example: Before posting the product photos online, the marketing team needs to touch them up to ensure a professional look.

words.chinese: 進展；吸引力；市場接受度；牽引力；附著力
words.engDef: the degree to which something is gaining acceptance
words.example: The new marketing campaign is designed to help our product gain traction in the market.

words.chinese: 貿易展覽；商展，通常用於展示新產品、技術或服務，並促進商業合作。
words.engDef: an exhibition where companies display their products
words.example: Our company will be exhibiting at the International Trade Show in Frankfurt next month.

words.chinese: 趨勢；發展方向（指市場、銷售、消費者行為等方面的變化或模式）
words.engDef: the general directions in which things are changing
words.example: The company needs to analyze current market trends to develop effective marketing strategies.

words.chinese: 時髦的；流行的（指符合當前潮流的風格或趨勢）
words.engDef: very fashionable at the moment
words.example: The company launched a new line of trendy accessories to attract younger consumers.

words.chinese: 試穿（衣服、鞋子等），以確認合適度。
words.engDef: to put on clothes to see if they fit
words.example: The customer is trying on several pairs of shoes to find the perfect fit.

words.chinese: 無可匹敵的；勝無可勝的；極其優秀
words.engDef: better than anything else, and impossible to beat
words.example: Our new product's features are unbeatable, giving us a significant advantage in the market.

words.chinese: 動詞：提高；提升（精神、士氣）；改善；使振奮。名詞：提升；增長（尤指銷售額或利潤）；鼓舞；精神振奮。
words.engDef: an increase or improvement, especially in sales or mood
words.example: The new marketing strategy is designed to uplift sales by 20% in the next quarter.

words.chinese: 情人節，通常指 2 月 14 日，是表達愛意和浪漫的節日。
words.engDef: a card sent on the fourteenth of February to show love
words.example: Our marketing campaign for Valentine's Day focuses on promoting couples' packages.

words.chinese: 販賣；出售（尤指小商品或透過自動販賣機出售的商品）
words.engDef: to sell goods, especially in small amounts
words.example: The machine vends snacks and beverages 24 hours a day.

words.chinese: 維諾娜（品牌名），指美國知名保養品品牌。
words.engDef: a name used for a brand
words.example: Our marketing campaign will heavily feature Venona's new anti-aging serum.

words.chinese: 充滿活力的；生機勃勃的；色彩鮮豔的
words.engDef: full of energy and bright colour
words.example: The company's new marketing campaign features a vibrant color palette to attract younger consumers.

words.chinese: 觀眾；收視者（指觀看電視、影片或參加活動的人）
words.engDef: people who watch television or a display
words.example: The marketing team is analyzing viewer demographics to tailor advertising campaigns.

words.chinese: 贏得比賽或競賽
words.engDef: to come first in a competition
words.example: Our marketing team hopes to win the advertising contest with their innovative campaign.

words.chinese: 櫥窗展示；商場櫥窗陳列
words.engDef: the arrangement of goods in a shop window
words.example: The store manager is responsible for designing eye-catching window displays to attract customers.

words.chinese: 櫥窗購物；瀏覽櫥窗而不購買商品
words.engDef: looking at goods in shop windows without buying
words.example: During the holiday season, many people enjoy window-shopping along the main street.

words.chinese: 得勝者；贏家；優勝者
words.engDef: the person or thing that comes first
words.example: Our team is determined to be the winner of this year's sales competition.

words.chinese: 獲勝的；勝利的；贏得的
words.engDef: coming first in a competition; also very attractive
words.example: The company's winning strategy resulted in a significant increase in sales.

words.chinese: 伍爾沃斯（Woolworth）是一家過去在美國及其他國家經營大型折扣零售商店的連鎖店，現已解散，但其品牌名稱仍被用於某些產品或子公司。
words.engDef: a family name once used for a chain of shops
words.example: Although Woolworth's department store chain no longer exists, its legacy in the retail industry remains significant.
